description: Flask application running in debug mode with Werkzeug debugger enabled. Debugger displays full error stack traces and application information to unauthenticated users on errors.
notes: Debug mode is ENABLED on this Flask application. When errors occur (tested with invalid POST to /login), the Werkzeug debugger displays full application stack traces including file paths and Python code. The debugger secret is visible in error responses: 5RkpfRq0jdB2f19HIDOo. This is a CRITICAL security issue as it allows remote code execution if the debugger PIN can be bypassed or obtained.
